snippet.title: Sea of Remnants | Gamescom 2026 - Official Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
※ Pre-register now: https://www.seaofremnants.com/

Sea of Remnants Closed Beta Test begins this December!

The Voyager remembers nothing, yet they are inexplicably drawn back to the same ocean.

Set sail in Sea of Remnants and embark on a recurring journey to recover lost memories.

Explore the sun-scorched shores of Cove Island, brave the rain-soaked jungles of Crazyleaves Isle, and delve into intricate Ruins crafted for the bold.

Command an ever-changing turn-based combat through epic encounters on land and sea.

🎵 Music: "Winds of Memories"
Performed by Jules Galli | Based on "The Bible or the Gun"
Licensed courtesy of Sony Music | Lyrics partially adapted by Ranbo - Gale (Vocals) | Molly (Bass) | Haig (Keys) | Cook (Drums)
